assistiti.intro: Seniors, adults, children and people with disabilities: every story is different. We build the assistance around the person and their family, not the other way round.

items.title: Seniors
items.body: Continuous home care, also for people with chronic conditions or dementia, and daily companionship to live at home safely.

items.title: Adults after a hospital stay
items.body: Care at home after a hospital stay or an operation and support during recovery, to get back to everyday life.

items.title: Children
items.body: Support for families of children and young people with illnesses or disabilities: we assess each situation together, case by case.

items.title: People with disabilities
items.body: Support for autonomy and continuous assistance, with nurses and OSS working on the same plan.

servizi.title: Everything you need, under one trusted care.
servizi.intro: Qualified professionals at home, in hospital and during every transfer. Each service is tailored to the person, not the diagnosis.

assistenza247.title: 24/7 care
assistenza247.body: Home shifts by day, by night and on holidays, up to round-the-clock presence.
assistenza247.longDescription: We arrange care at home for the hours you actually need: nights, weekends, holidays, up to full 24-hour coverage with several carers taking turns. We try to keep the same carers, so the person sees familiar faces; if a carer is absent, we find the replacement. This service does not replace emergency services: in a medical emergency, call 112 immediately.
bullets: The same carers, as far as possible
If a carer is absent, we find the replacement

oss.title: Healthcare assistants (OSS)
oss.body: Our healthcare assistants provide qualified, compassionate support for daily care, preserving dignity, autonomy and well-being.
oss.longDescription: Dedicare's healthcare assistants are selected for both technical skill and human empathy. They support the patient with daily activities discreetly and respectfully, ease the family's caregiving load and become a steady, familiar presence in the home — capable of restoring rhythm, calm and connection.

accompagnamento.title: Accompaniment
accompagnamento.body: One of our carers accompanies the person to visits, tests and therapies, and assists them when travelling too.
accompagnamento.longDescription: We accompany the person to outpatient clinics, day hospitals, clinics and specialist visits with one of our carers, and with a nurse at your request or on a doctor's advice. On request, we can also assist the person while travelling. We plan schedules, paperwork and logistics with you, from leaving home to getting back.
bullets: A nurse at your request or on a doctor's advice

multidisciplinare.title: Multidisciplinary approach
multidisciplinare.body: Nurses and OSS work on the same plan; if other professionals are needed, we help you find them and coordinate with them.
multidisciplinare.longDescription: Nurses and healthcare assistants (OSS) work on the same care plan and share information and goals. If other professionals are needed, for example a physiotherapist, we help you find them and coordinate with them. This way the care adapts when needs change and the family has a single point of reference.
bullets: Other professionals: we help you find them

cambio.title: At 06:00 the night shift hands over to the day shift.
cambio.body: We try to keep the same carers, so the person sees familiar faces; if a carer is absent, we find the replacement.

perche.intro: Every detail of our service is designed to bring relief to the family and dignity to the person being cared for.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.intro: Can't find the answer you're looking for? Write to us or give us a call.

items.a: We assist seniors, adults after a hospital stay, children and people with physical or cognitive disabilities who need care at home, in hospital or during transfers, in Milan and the surrounding area.

items.q: Is the first consultation really free?
items.a: Yes, completely. A no-obligation phone or WhatsApp call to understand your needs, answer your questions and propose the best solution. Call or write to us at +39 388 253 6992.

items.q: What qualifications do your staff have?
items.a: We work with healthcare assistants (OSS) holding the OSS qualification and with nurses registered with the Order of Nursing Professions (OPI). Before the start we tell you the qualification of whoever will come into your home.

items.q: Do you operate only in Milan or also in nearby areas?
items.a: We work in Milan and in the towns of Greater Milan. Availability depends on the carers in your area: contact us and we will check it together. For more distant areas we evaluate travel on request.

items.q: How does night-time and weekend care work?
items.a: We arrange shifts at night, at weekends and on holidays, up to round-the-clock presence with several carers taking turns. In a medical emergency, always call 112.

items.q: Are home care expenses tax-deductible in Italy?
items.a: Some care expenses give the right to Italian income tax (IRPEF) deductions, within the limits and conditions set by law: they depend on the type of service, the condition of the person cared for and the income of whoever pays, and they require a traceable payment. We issue a regular invoice; to find out whether you can deduct the expense and with which documents, ask a CAF or your accountant.

Call us on +39 388 253 6992 or write to info@dedicaresolutions.it. After the free consultation and the assessment, we agree the start date together: if a carer is available in your area, it can be within a few days.

curriculum.title: Join the Dedicare team
curriculum.intro: We're looking for professionals who share our way of caring: clinical expertise, genuine listening and a steady human presence. Send us your CV — we read every application personally.

reasons.title: Continuous training
reasons.body: Ongoing clinical updates, initial mentoring and clear internal growth paths.

reasons.title: Human workplace
reasons.body: Close clinical coordination, sustainable shifts and real listening to the people who work with us.

reasons.title: Proper contracts
reasons.body: Italian CCNL framework, professional liability coverage and reliable payments.

reasons.title: Close to home
reasons.body: We assign patients in your area of Greater Milan: less commuting and more time devoted to care.

curriculum.hint_cv: Include in your CV only information useful for the selection: no health data, religious or political beliefs, or details about family members.
curriculum.informativa: By submitting your application you confirm that you have read the <privacyLink>candidate privacy notice</privacyLink> (in Italian).
